children: RNS Number : 2333V  Everplay Group plc  17 September 2026

everplay group plc, a leading global independent (“indie”) developer and publisher of premium video games, working simulation games and children’s edutainment apps announces that it has received a notification from Debbie Bestwick, Non-Executive Director of the Company that on 17 September 2026 she gifted 791,557 ordinary shares of £0.01 each in the Company ("Ordinary Shares") to Active Respite.

Active Respite is a UK charity founded in 2022 and fully funded by Debbie Bestwick. The charity provides financial and practical support to children and families in need, promoting children’s educational and physical wellbeing.
Following this gift, Ms Bestwick’s interest in Ordinary Shares is as follows:
Mikkel Weider, Group Chief Executive Officer
Rashid Varachia, Group Chief Financial Officer and Chief Operating Officer
James Targett, Group Investor Relations and Communications Director
Peel Hunt (Nominated Advisor and Joint Corporate Broker)
Neil Patel / Benjamin Cryer / Kate Bannatyne
Jeremy Garcia / Fiona Hetherington / Safia Colebrook

everplay group plc is an award-winning and leading global indie games label developer and publisher of premium video games and apps, comprising three distinct divisions: Team17, Astragon and StoryToys. Team17 is a games developer, publisher and creative partner for indie developers around the world, known for iconic IP such as Hell Let Loose, Worms, Wardogs, Dredge and Overcooked!. Astragon is a leading games publisher, developer and distributor of sophisticated working simulation games, including Construction Simulator and Police Simulator, targeting a broad audience from young enthusiasts to technical experts and casual gamers. StoryToys is a world-class developer and publisher of educational entertainment apps, bringing the world's most popular characters, worlds and stories to life for children under the age of eight, with apps including Disney Colouring World and LEGO® Bluey.
Visit www.everplaygroupplc.com for more information or follow us on LinkedIn: everplay group plc
